records.description: EMS work mode for the physical dispatch kernel. Auto evaluates battery-first, grid-first, scheduled AM/PM and dynamic clipping reserve for the active system and picks the highest median equity NPV mode; the sidebar stays Auto until a recommendation is applied. Battery-first is the standard self-use inverter mode (Load -> Battery -> Grid). Grid-first exports sub-inverter surplus and only charges from over-inverter DC power (Load -> Clipping Recapture -> Grid -> Battery). Scheduled AM/PM uses grid-first before the switch hour during the configured active months to preserve midday clipping headroom. Dynamic clipping reserve caps morning sub-inverter charging at SoC ceiling = usable capacity minus remaining over-inverter capturable energy.
